metadata.notes: Central bank inflation forecasts and policy rates

US.source_full: Federal Reserve - Summary of Economic Projections
US.note: Fed projects core PCE inflation. Expects only 1 cut in 2026.
US.key_quote: Core inflation revised slightly lower for 2026

EA.note: ECB expects inflation below 2% in 2026-27 before returning to target.
EA.key_quote: Inflation projected to decrease to 1.9% in 2026

UK.source_full: Bank of England - Monetary Policy Report
UK.note: BoE expects inflation to fall below 2% target by Q2 2027.
UK.key_quote: CPI inflation projected to slow to 2.5% by Q4 2026

CA.source_full: Bank of Canada - Monetary Policy Report
CA.note: BoC expects inflation to remain near 2% target through 2027.
CA.key_quote: Inflation expected to stay close to 2% target

AU.source_full: Reserve Bank of Australia - Statement on Monetary Policy
AU.note: RBA focuses on trimmed mean inflation, expects return to target band.
AU.key_quote: Underlying inflation expected to return to target range

NZ.source_full: Reserve Bank of New Zealand - Monetary Policy Statement
NZ.note: RBNZ expects inflation to settle near 2% midpoint.

ZA.source_full: South African Reserve Bank - MPC Statement
ZA.note: New 3% target (±1pp) announced Nov 2025, replacing 25-year-old 3-6% range. On track to meet target by 2026.
ZA.key_quote: On course to meet new 3% inflation target in 2026

JP.source_full: Bank of Japan - Outlook for Economic Activity and Prices
JP.forecast_type: Median Policy Board forecast (core CPI ex-fresh food)
JP.note: BoJ uses fiscal year (April-March). FY2025 = Apr 2025 - Mar 2026. Core CPI excludes fresh food.
JP.key_quote: Underlying inflation expected to reach level consistent with 2% target

CN.note: PBoC does not publish inflation forecasts. IMF projections used. Deflationary pressures persist.
CN.key_quote: Deflationary pressures amid weak domestic demand
